ruling_basis: docs/WALK-RATIFICATION-EXECUTION-HANDOFF.md sec.2.5 (final arithmetic) and sec.3 step 6 (assembly). Supersedes experiments/out/foundry/det_patterns_probe.json as the RATIFIED pattern set -- that file remains the raw measurement tool/log, this file is the versioned, Captain-ratified artifact.
arithmetic: The walk's own prose claimed '41/306 DET-able' but its own sec.2.4 table (and the committed foundry_det_patterns_probe.py PATTERNS list, verified against a pre-session backup) only ever had 39 rows -- a pre-existing internal inconsistency in the original walk output, not introduced this session (B2 ruling, 2026-07-31: 39 is authoritative, annotated not silently corrected in the source doc). 39 (original) - 1 (rule:kicker-conditional-bonus-effect, withdrawn per Q9) + 4 (new rule:cant-be-blocked-<restriction> family patterns, Q8.5/Q8.8) + 1 (rule:cant-be-blocked-by-controller, B1 follow-on ruling) + 1 (rule:imposes-enters-tapped, captain-authored per the B3/B4 follow-on ruling) = 44 ratified patterns. The 4 pre-existing unblockable-family patterns (rule:innate-unblockable, rule:activated-grants-self-unblockable, rule:grants-unblockable, rule:grants-unblockable-target) were REBUILT in place (same slug, corrected regex per Q8.8's restriction-boundary) -- not counted as net removed/added since the axis structure itself wasn't consolidated (Q8.4 minimal-churn ruling).
preprocessing_standard: DET preprocessing standard v1 (2026-07-31 follow-on, B3/B4): every pattern below runs against foundry_common.det_scan_texts(card), not full_oracle_text() directly -- CARDNAME canonicalization (a card's own printed name/short-form self-reference replaces to the '~' token before matching) and modal-mode bullet splitting (each 'Choose one -- * ...' bullet scans as its own synthetic unit alongside the header), joining the existing polarity/templating-era/all-faces rules into one standing pipeline. Re-probing all patterns under this standard changed 5 hit counts (see session diff): rule:innate-unblockable (161->183, CARDNAME), rule:activated-grants-self-unblockable (22->25, CARDNAME), rule:enters-tapped (685->686, a per-clause G2 fix landing alongside this work), rule:landfall-gain-life (13->15, modal) and rule:landfall-self-pump (38->41, modal); all other patterns unchanged.
standing_condition: sec.2.5: at DET-pass time each ratified pattern emits a fixed-seed 20-hit sample sheet (seed = 20260731 + pattern_index, this file's 'seed' field per entry). ANY sample row failing its axis definition halts the pass before provenance writes. Patterns are versioned like scoring constants -- never silently tuned. This file WAS updated in place once, 2026-07-31, for the B1/B3/B4 follow-on rulings issued in the same session as v1's original assembly (pre-launch iteration, not post-launch tuning -- no DET pass had run yet). Any future change AFTER Captain's step-4 go-ahead requires a new docs/det-patterns-v2.json, not an in-place edit.

patterns.def_anchor: An activated ability can only be used during combat, restricting its use to that phase.
patterns.note: activation-restriction family (D-4 closed, DET-owned)

patterns.def_anchor: An activated ability can only be used during the controller's own turn (not restricted further to a specific phase like upkeep or to sorcery-speed/empty-stack timing).
patterns.note: activation-restriction family

patterns.def_anchor: An activated ability that can only be used during a specific phase of the controller's turn, namely their own upkeep.
patterns.note: activation-restriction family

patterns.def_anchor: An activated ability can only be used at times when the controller could cast a sorcery, restricting its use to their own main phase with an empty stack.
patterns.note: activation-restriction family

patterns.def_anchor: An effect that creates a token specifies it enters the battlefield tapped, delaying its immediate usability.
patterns.note: 'create a tapped ... token' (adjective-before-noun, the dominant print form) OR 'create ... token. It enters tapped' (verified against 5 live members -- all use the adjective form, e.g. Koilos Roc 'create a tapped Powerstone token')

patterns.def_anchor: The permanent enters the battlefield tapped, delaying its immediate usability as a cost/drawback.
patterns.note: broad pre-filter; conditional variant subtracted separately below

patterns.pattern: \benters?(?: the battlefield)? tapped\b,? (?:unless|if)|unless [^.]*,? [^.]*enters? tapped|if [^.]* enters? tapped
patterns.def_anchor: The permanent enters tapped unless a stated condition is met (or a stated condition is what makes it enter tapped) -- contrast rule:enters-tapped's unconditional sibling.
patterns.note: both-polarity: 'tapped unless/if' AND the reversed 'unless X, ~ enters tapped' shape (Lesson 1)

patterns.def_anchor: When this permanent enters, it taps a target artifact or creature and applies stun counters, disabling it for multiple turns rather than just the current one.
patterns.note: ETB clause containing both 'tap' and 'stun counter'

patterns.def_anchor: The creature must attack every combat if it is able to, removing its controller's discretion over attacking.
patterns.note: CR 508.1a fixed phrase, self-scoped

patterns.note: CR 508.1a fixed phrase, all-creatures scoped

patterns.def_anchor: An activated ability grants the controller an additional turn after the current one.

patterns.pattern: gets? \+(?:\d+|[Xx])/\+(?:\d+|[Xx]) and gains flying|gains flying and gets \+(?:\d+|[Xx])/\+(?:\d+|[Xx])

patterns.pattern: other creatures you control have trample

patterns.cr_anchor: CR 113.12 (stated quality, corrected 2026-07-31 from an unverified 509.1h citation); terminology law, CODEBOOK-NAMING-GRAMMAR.md sec.14/Q8.2
patterns.def_anchor: DELIVERY: activated (a paid cost) for all current members. SCOPE: mixed -- self (Leitmotif Composer grants it to creatures sharing its own name; Guild Thief grants it to itself) and target (Key to the City, up to one target creature; Temmet, Vizier of Naktamun, a target creature token you control; Rogue's Passage, target creature). DURATION: this turn (eot) for all current members. EFFECT: absolute unblockable per the terminology law (CODEBOOK-NAMING-GRAMMAR.md sec.14, Q8.2) -- no restriction rider on any current member. Quote-checked 2026-07-31, all 5 clean.
patterns.note: Q8.8 rebuild: dropped the old 'as long as' branch (now routes to cant-be-blocked-<restriction>); requires the eot duration marker since granted-unblockable effects are inherently temporary (distinguishes from rule:innate-unblockable's unmarked/permanent shape)

patterns.pattern: target creature can'?t be blocked(?!(?:\s+this turn)?(?:\s+until end of turn)?\s*,?\s*(?:except by|by creatures with|unless|as long as))
patterns.cr_anchor: CR 113.12 (stated quality, corrected 2026-07-31 from an unverified 509.1h citation); terminology law, CODEBOOK-NAMING-GRAMMAR.md sec.14/Q8.2
patterns.def_anchor: DELIVERY: mixed across current members -- static (Protective Bubble, an Aura's continuous ability), etb-trigger (Long River Lurker), activated (Wormhole Serpent, Soratami Mirror-Guard). SCOPE: target (a chosen creature, not the source) for all members. DURATION: this turn (eot) for all except Protective Bubble (static, continuous while the Aura is attached). EFFECT: absolute unblockable per the terminology law (CODEBOOK-NAMING-GRAMMAR.md sec.14, Q8.2) for all 10 current members -- The Black Gate's by-controller restriction rider moved to rule:cant-be-blocked-by-controller (B1 ruling, 2026-07-31), resolving the prior flag.
patterns.note: Q8.8 rebuild: added the restriction-continuation guard (see KNOWN RESIDUAL GAP note above re: The Black Gate)

patterns.pattern: (?:this creature|\~) can'?t be blocked(?!(?:\s+this turn)?(?:\s+until end of turn)?\s*,?\s*(?:except by|by creatures with|unless|as long as))
patterns.cr_anchor: CR 113.12 (stated quality, corrected 2026-07-31 from an unverified 509.1h citation); terminology law, CODEBOOK-NAMING-GRAMMAR.md sec.14/Q8.2
patterns.def_anchor: The permanent has a static ability making it inherently unblockable, without needing an activated cost.
patterns.note: Q8.8 rebuild: replaced the old partial '(?!except)' guard with the full 4-phrase restriction-continuation guard. PREVIOUSLY a known gap (pronoun/proper-noun subject anchor missed 5/11 current members: 'It', 'Sygg', 'Willie Lumpkin', 'Ukkima') -- FIXED by the DET preprocessing standard v1 (CARDNAME canonicalization, 2026-07-31 follow-on): proper-noun self-references now canonicalize to the ~ token before matching. 'It' pronoun self-reference (Creeping Tar Pit) remains a separate, unaddressed gap -- pronoun coreference, not CARDNAME canonicalization.

patterns.pattern: (?:\{[^}]*\}|\b(?:Sacrifice|Discard|Remove|Tap|Exile|Pay)\b[^.:\n]*)[^.]*:[^.]*(?:this (?:creature|permanent)|\~) can'?t be blocked(?!(?:\s+this turn)?(?:\s+until end of turn)?\s*,?\s*(?:except by|by creatures with|unless|as long as))
patterns.cr_anchor: CR 113.12 (stated quality, corrected 2026-07-31 from an unverified 509.1h citation); CR 113.3b (activated ability cost)
patterns.def_anchor: DELIVERY: activated (a paid mana cost) for all current members. SCOPE: self (the source becomes unblockable). DURATION: this turn (eot). EFFECT: absolute unblockable per the terminology law (CODEBOOK-NAMING-GRAMMAR.md sec.14, Q8.2) -- no restriction rider on any current member. Quote-checked 2026-07-31 (Harbor Bandit, Daring Saboteur): both read "{cost}: This creature can't be blocked this turn." -- clean.
patterns.note: activated-cost self-unblockable (F2 sweep: cost isn't always a mana/tap symbol -- 'Sacrifice X:', 'Discard a card:', 'Remove a counter:' etc. are equally valid activation costs; excludes loyalty-ability '−N:' costs by requiring one of these literal cost words, verified against the corpus not to pick up Vronos, Masked Inquisitor's quoted grant text. Q8.8 rebuild: added the restriction-continuation guard. DET preprocessing standard v1: CARDNAME token added as a subject alternative)

patterns.pattern: can'?t be blocked except by (?!two\b)[a-z0-9-]+ or more creatures
patterns.cr_anchor: CR 113.12 (stated quality, corrected 2026-07-31 from an unverified 509.1h citation); contrast case CR 702.111a (Menace, keyword-owned, excluded)
patterns.note: corpus-verified: excluding 'two' specifically excludes Menace's fixed reminder text (0/244 'two or more' hits lack the word 'menace' nearby -- 100% Menace-owned); 'three or more'/'six or more' etc. are genuine non-keyword variants (10 hits)

patterns.pattern: can'?t be blocked as long as (?!defending player controls\b)[^.\n]*

patterns.pattern: can'?t be blocked by creatures (?:that|who|your opponents?|[a-z' ]*player)[^.\n]*controls?

patterns.note: B1 ruling (2026-07-31, post-execution follow-on): new restriction-vocab value, names WHO may not block rather than what the blocker is like. Corpus-verified 2 hits: The Black Gate (quote-verified member, moved from rule:grants-unblockable-target) and Rikku, Resourceful Guardian (corpus candidate, NOT added as a member -- B1 only ordered Black Gate's move)

patterns.def_anchor: An additional cost may be paid at cast time to unlock a bonus effect that only occurs if that extra cost was paid.

patterns.note: F2 fix: landfall ability word + 'add ... mana' in same paragraph (was sentence-scoped [^.]* and symbol-only \{ -- Omnath, Locus of Creation's landfall clause has a period between the ability-word sentence and the 'add {R}{G}{W}{U}' sentence, AND the pattern must also catch prose mana description with no {} symbol at all, e.g. 'add one mana of any color')

patterns.def_anchor: Whenever a land the controller controls enters, the permanent grants itself a temporary power/toughness boost until end of turn.
patterns.note: landfall ability word + self-pump in same paragraph (F2 sweep: paragraph-scoped not sentence-scoped, and pump amount may be X. KNOWN GAP, flagged not silently dropped: single-line scoping intentionally does NOT cross a newline, so a modal 'choose one —' + bulleted pump option on its own line (Retreat to Hagra/Valakut) isn't caught -- an unbounded cross-newline window was tested and rejected because it produces real false positives, matching an unrelated static pump ability elsewhere on the same card, e.g. Moraug/Maja Bretagard Protector/Springheart Nantuko; modal-bullet handling needs per-mode text splitting, out of scope for this sweep)

patterns.pattern: [same base pattern as rule:enters-tapped] + subject classified 'imposed' (bare plural class noun -- artifacts?/lands?/creatures?/permanents?/tokens?, optionally with 'you control'/'your opponents control'/'played by opponents' suffix, with NO self-reference word (this/it/that/the/CARDNAME) present)
patterns.def_anchor: A static ability makes OTHER permanents (not the source itself) enter the battlefield tapped -- the Root Maze class: a class filter (artifacts/lands/creatures/permanents, optionally scoped to an opponent's, a specific player's, or a type-qualified subset) rather than a self-reference. Sibling of rule:enters-tapped (self) and rule:enters-tapped-conditional; discovered as a systematic false-positive risk on rule:enters-tapped's own DET pattern (G2 guard, walk-ratification 2026-07-31) and authored as its own axis per Captain's explicit instruction rather than left as an unlabeled exclusion list.
